name: @winstonsayno/mcp-gateway
stderr:
Usage: mcp-gateway [options] [command]

A lightweight gateway for managing multiple MCP servers

Options:
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]              Start the MCP gateway server
  init [options]               Generate a default configuration file
  desktop [options]            Write a desktop profile (loopback, generated
                               key, offline mode) importing the MCP servers of
                               a desktop client
  validate [options]           Validate a configuration file and report
                               security warnings
  diff [options]               Show what applying a config file would change
                               (against a running gateway, or another file with
                               --against)
  apply [options]              Apply a config file to a running gateway (hot
                               reload over the admin API; needs
                               controlPlane.configApi: true)
  policy                       Policy-as-code tools
  tenancy                      Tenant isolation tools (14.2.0)
  hash-key [key]               Print the sha256:<hex> digest of an API key, for
                               auth.apiKeys (reads stdin when no key is given)
  gen-key [options]            Generate a random API key and print it with its
                               sha256 digest
  operator [options]           Run the Kubernetes operator: reconcile
                               McpGateway resources (in-cluster service
                               account)
  migrate [options]            Rewrite a config file to schema v11 (or --to 10
                               / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5 / 4), keeping comments;
                               prints the changes
  config                       Config schema tools: migrate a schema v11 file
                               to schema v12 (14.0), diff, roll back
  bench [options]              Benchmark an in-process gateway with a local
                               echo server (REST, auth, cache, /mcp)
  plugin                       Signed plugins: keygen, sign, verify
  pq                           Post-quantum (ML-DSA) hybrid keys — EXPERIMENTAL
  conformance [options] <url>  Run the MCP conformance suite against a
                               Streamable HTTP endpoint (e.g.
                               http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp)
  tasks                        Durable task runs (14.4): list, inspect, resume,
                               cancel, approve / deny, and the failure queue
                               (DLQ)
  regions                      Multi-region consistency (14.5): report, health,
                               replicated revocations
  edge                         Edge autonomy (14.6): offline report, queue,
                               reconcile
  gitops                       GitOps (14.7): render config directories, env
                               diffs, signed releases, plan / apply / status
  help [command]               display help for command
